name: delegate-popover
title: Delegate Popover
description: Delegate a record or rows to an agent: search agents (disabled with a reason), instructions, When finished, Connect an agent; bulk, empty and loading states.

meta.whenToUse: Delegating a task or table rows to an agent from the Delegate property, a peek pill, the D key or a bulk bar.
meta.whenNotToUse: Assigning a person (PeoplePicker), or showing an agent already on the work (AgentPanel).
